name: comp-282
description: Alert banner spanning full width, typically used at top or bottom of page sections for site-wide informational messages.
use_when: Displaying important announcements, maintenance notices, or site-wide messages that should be highly visible.
avoid_when: Inline alerts within forms or cards. When space is constrained.
a11y: No ARIA attributes. Parent should add role='region' aria-label='announcement' and aria-live if content updates dynamically.
